title: MCP protocol: the USB-C of AI that connects every LLM to every tool

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: MCP is the universal protocol that unifies all AI and tools, just like USB-C unifies devices—no more fragmented ecosystems.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But MCP isn’t standardized. Real protocols like HTTP and TCP/IP work because they’re open, well-documented, and widely adopted.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: MCP already supports real-time inference, secure API tunnels, and dynamic model swapping—features no other protocol offers.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: That’s marketing. Real AI systems rely on open, versioned APIs, not proprietary black boxes that lock developers into closed ecosystems.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Open protocols drive innovation. MCP is a cage, not a bridge.
